language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Welcome to Antarctica! My name is Solveig and I am from Norway. My mom owns a clothing store in a research station and I get to help her everyday after school.
We are all preparing for the annual Summer Thaw Dinner and Dance. The theme this year is number patterns.

Can you figure out the rule for the following number pattern?
2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12

That’s right! The rule for this number pattern is to add two to get the next number. What about this pattern?
1, 5, 10, 16, 23, 31
This one is much tougher! We began by adding 4 to the first number to get 5, and then added 4 + 1 to get the second number, and then added 4 + 2 to get the third number, and so on.
Why don’t you come help me at the store? We’ll have great fun!
Wow! We should have a great time helping Solveig with all of those number patterns. Let’s get started!
